comments.text: That mini backpack fits so much more than it looks like it should, and the little pouches keep everything tidy. The Hello Kitty card holder is such a sweet touch too.

I was looking at tomtoc pouches after your video and they make one that is like a travel/tech pouch it’s 8.27 x 5.12 x 3.15. It is the perfect organizer hack for a lot of my bags that are similar in size and shape. It’s a perfect fit for my Strathberry Mosaic bags, The Horse Clementine bag, Puzzle bags etc. I can just organize everything in the pouch and I can switch bags in seconds because it works in so many bags I own. I’m going to look at other sizes to see if I can find one for slightly larger bags. Thanks for tip! 😊
